summary: 23 batches (~170 WQ simulations). D0 submit bar = Sharpe>2.0 & Fitness>1.3 (delay-driven). Risk-model neutralizations (STATISTICAL/CROWDING/FAST/SLOW) LOCKED on this tier -> the standard lever to reach D0 Sharpe 2.0 is unavailable. After exhaustively combining reversal + value + quality + asset-turnover (4 orthogonal axes), tuning neutralization/decay/truncation/universe/weights, and testing accruals/buyback/capex/sentiment/news/momentum/vector_neut, the D0 ceiling is a HARD asymptote at Sharpe ~1.88 (FIT 1.31-1.52, passes EVERY submit check except the 2.0 Sharpe bar). The SAME factor at delay=1 passes ALL submit checks.
factor_economics: Cross-sectional VALUE (sales/price + EBIT/price + gross-profitability quality) MINUS short-horizon price OVERREACTION/REVERSAL (de-meaned price ts_av_diff + price-volume correlation + risk-adjusted reversal). Long cheap+profitable+oversold names, short expensive+over-extended names. Regularized with gaussian-quantile + subindustry group_zscore + ts_backfill. No IV / option fields.

best_D0.expression: subtract(add(add(add(group_zscore(quantile(ts_backfill(divide(sales, cap), 22), driver=gaussian), subindustry), group_zscore(quantile(ts_backfill(divide(est_ebit, cap), 22), driver=gaussian), subindustry)), group_zscore(quantile(ts_backfill(divide(est_grossincome, est_tot_assets), 22), driver=gaussian), subindustry)), group_zscore(quantile(ts_backfill(divide(sales, est_tot_assets), 22), driver=gaussian), subindustry)), multiply(1.2, add(add(group_zscore(quantile(ts_av_diff(close, 15), driver=gaussian), subindustry), group_zscore(quantile(ts_corr(close, volume, 15), driver=gaussian), subindustry)), group_zscore(quantile(divide(ts_av_diff(close, 15), ts_std_dev(returns, 30)), driver=gaussian), subindustry))))
best_D0.economic_axes: value(sales/price,ebit/price)+quality(gross profitability)+efficiency(asset turnover) MINUS short-term reversal(price de-mean, price-volume corr, risk-adjusted reversal)
